cohort: Korean women from the Health Insurance Review and Assessment-National Patient Sample (HIRA-NPS) database, 2012-2016
finding: The prevalence of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and cesarean section rates in women with GDM showed a significant increasing trend in Korea from 2012 to 2016.
mod_finding: The study found a significantly increasing trend in cesarean section rates in women with gestational diabetes mellitus from 2012 to 2016.
